**Answer: Black Condor II (Ryan Kendall) died in *Infinite Crisis* #1 (DC Comics, 2005).**

- Kendall, the second Black Condor, was killed in *Infinite Crisis* #1. He was a Freedom Fighters member, and Sinestro killed him during an ambush by the Secret Society of Super Villains. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Condor
- Comics Central's character page lists "Issue Died: Infinite Crisis #1". Source: https://comicscentral.net/ryan-kendall-4005-76170/
- Comics Central says Sinestro's opening blast pierced him through the chest. Human Bomb and Phantom Lady died alongside him, and the Society hung their bodies at the top of the Washington Monument. Source: https://comicscentral.net/ryan-kendall-4005-76170/
- He later appeared after death in *Nightwing* and in *Blackest Night*, where he came back as a Black Lantern. Source: https://comicscentral.net/ryan-kendall-4005-76170/

**Limits:** I found no source that disagrees. But both sources are secondary, and I didn't see the issue's pages. I tried to read Comic Vine and the DC Fandom wiki, but both returned HTTP 403.
